systems.name: Public Employees Retirement Association of New Mexico

statute.quote: "association" means the public employees retirement association established under the Public Employees Retirement Act;

source.quote: The "retirement board" is created and is the trustee of the association and the funds created by the state retirement system acts

website_source.quote: Public Employees Retirement Association (PERA) of New Mexico PERA Receives GFOA Award

covers_local_source.quote: "public employer" means the state, any municipality, city, county, metropolitan arroyo flood control authority, economic development district, regional housing authority, soil and water conservation district

systems.notes: Census units are PERA-administered funds: Public Employees' Retirement Fund, Judicial Retirement Fund (10-12B), Magistrate Retirement Fund (10-12C) and Volunteer Firefighters Retirement Fund (created by 10-11A-3). No section establishing the association itself was found; definition used.
